personality_one_liner: A clean, reliable, and friendly fintech interface that turns weather risk into a clear, approachable guarantee.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Use 'md' or 'lg' for layout gaps. Large numbers get extra isolation to emphasize metrics. Use 8px grid foundation.

do's: Use glass for sticky header over scrolling content
Apply glass overlay on the hero featured image card
Use blur on modal scrim entries for the settlement replay
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields or standard list rows
Avoid on data-heavy numeric portions of the Merchant Dashboard to preserve clarity

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: Introduce the value proposition, how it works, and show a live ticker of city rain odds.

states.loading: Skeleton text and blank hero card
states.error: Failed to load ticker data, show 'Live odds unavailable' fallback

screens.layout: Scrollable. Top: Hero section featuring a blurred background photo overlay with strong value proposition 'Rain shouldn't cost you customers'. Middle: 3 stacked cards for 'How it works' (clean, vertical stack). Bottom: A horizontally scrolling live ticker pill-row displaying 5 cities with % odds. Sticky bottom primary CTA 'Get Started'.

screens.name: MerchantOnboarding
screens.layout: Single column form list. Large clear labels above inputs. Native pickers for Business Type and City. A persistent, sticky CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: CustomerCheckoutWidget
screens.purpose: A simulated environment showcasing what the customer sees at checkout.
screens.layout: Centered simulated phone screen/card. Inside: A polished widget container (surfaceTertiary background if active). Displays 'Rain chance 12% · Rain refund $5.70' in strong typography, a trailing switch/toggle, and subtle trigger text below. Incorporates a small umbrella or rain icon from Phosphor.

screens.name: MerchantDashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a live operational view of risk, P&L, and market depth for the merchant.

states.loading: Full screen skeleton prioritizing the top numbers
states.empty: Illustration of a sunny day, 'No active guarantees sold yet' + 'View setup' CTA
states.error: Data fetch error with Retry CTA

screens.layout: Fintech dashboard structure. Top: Large 'Guarantees Sold' and 'Contracts Held' metrics (Space Grotesk, largest font scale). Middle: 2-column flex-wrap grid for 'If it rains' / 'If it doesn't' P&L cards. Lower Middle: Live price and order book depth (compact list style). Bottom: Hedge order log.

screens.name: SettlementReplay
screens.purpose: Educate the merchant by animating a past market settlement event.
screens.layout: Focus-oriented screen. Date picker at the top. The center contains a visual sequence/timeline that lights up sequentially (using reanimated): Market Settled -> N Refunds Issued -> Hedge Payout. Big numbers, distinct states (success green for payout, default grey for pending).

hero_background.alt: Rainy cafe patio with brick wall and greenery

merchant_event.alt: Customer using payment terminal at an outdoor event

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality constraints. The user explicitly requested a 'rain/blue palette', so the primary brand color is a trustworthy vibrant blue (#2563EB). Use this as an accent against clean white backgrounds.
Utilize 'Space Grotesk' for all large numbers and metrics in the Merchant Dashboard and Checkout Widget to give it a modern fintech look, while using 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for labels and body text.
Make sure the Customer Checkout Widget is rendered cleanly as a mock phone frame or a prominent card in its own screen to simulate the B2B2C offering.
For the Merchant Dashboard, rely on fintech patterns: largest visual weight at the top for primary metrics, 2-column grid for the P&L scenario cards, and a clean list for the order book depth.
Settlement replay must be an interactive animation. Use react-native-reanimated to sequence the 'Market settled' -> 'Refunds' -> 'Payout' timeline.
Remember to implement the Pitch Footer ('Settled on official Weather Company... Kalshi') as a fixed or bottom-scrolling element on the Landing and Dashboard screens. Keep the text muted.
Ensure the hero image has a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim when text is placed over it to guarantee WCAG contrast ratios.
